name: dudeling
description: A tutor that teaches on a whiteboard inside your chat: Claude explains while Dudeling draws and talks.
long_description:
Ask Claude to teach you something. Dudeling opens a whiteboard in the conversation, draws as it explains out loud, and checks what you learned. Talk or type on the board to ask, answer or interrupt.

The voice and speech recognition run on your computer: audio never leaves it and no account or key is needed. What you say (as text), type or draw on the board is given to Claude as part of your conversation. Lessons are kept on this computer for 30 days.

For Apple-silicon Macs and 64-bit Windows PCs (Intel/AMD), in English.

tools.name: open_board
tools.description: Open a whiteboard for the lesson.

tools.name: teach_part
tools.description: Teach one part: the board draws and narrates it.

tools.name: reply_and_listen
tools.description: Reply out loud, then hear what the learner says or types on the board.

tools.name: resume_board
tools.description: Carry on with the paused part.

tools.name: clear_board
tools.description: Start a different topic on the same board.

tools.name: look_at_board
tools.description: See the board, including the learner's drawing.

tools.name: dudeling_guide
tools.description: How to teach well with Dudeling.

prompts.name: teach-me
prompts.description: Learn a topic on Dudeling's whiteboard.
prompts.text: Tutor me on ${arguments.topic} with Dudeling: read dudeling_guide first, open one board, then teach one part at a time with teach_part, calling reply_and_listen after each to hear me on the board.
